valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2022 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2022
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 1.43103e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2022, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 1.43103e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: a growth rate of earnings cannot be computed: it needs net profit in two consecutive ANNUAL periods, and the statements on file do not carry two. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (lifehealthcaregroupholdingslimited) is served under two keys, LHC.JO and LHC, that stand on DIFFERENT filings: LHC.JO is the fresher period on file, so LHC is superseded and withheld while LHC.JO publishes the current year. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
